description: Green 5 mm LED, GaP (our fit to Kingbright WP7113GD's sheet)

source.licence: Our own fit to the maker's datasheet curve (D-156): the values are Solum Builder's

rating_sources.if_avg: Kingbright WP7113GD data sheet, Spec No DSAE9335, Rev. V.12B (04/02/2019), Absolute maximum ratings: DC forward current 25 mA
rating_sources.vr_max: Kingbright WP7113GD data sheet, Spec No DSAE9335, Rev. V.12B (04/02/2019), Absolute maximum ratings: reverse voltage 5 V

fit.sheet: Kingbright WP7113GD data sheet, Spec No DSAE9335, Rev. V.12B (04/02/2019)
fit.figure: Forward Current vs. Forward Voltage (page 3), read from the PDF's vector drawing
fit.method: IS, N and RS by least squares on V = N·Vt·ln(I/IS) + RS·I (scripts/fit_models.py fit_diode, Vt at 27 °C) over every other curve point from 1 mA up; CJO is the sheet's capacitance; BV 5 V, IBV 10 µA: the sheet's reverse current limit at 5 V
fit.note: Below 1 mA the linear-scale figure can't be read, so the fit's low-current behaviour is the diode equation's, not the sheet's

package.name: T-1 3/4 (5 mm)
package.source: Kingbright WP7113GD data sheet: T-1 3/4 (5mm) Solid State Lamp; pins numbered by KiCad's convention, 1 cathode, 2 anode: the sheet doesn't number the leads (the user, 2026-10-29, D-159). The cathode is the short lead, by the flat on the rim
